mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may impair armodafinil metabolism and increase CNS stimulant effects; armodafinil may mask symptoms of systemic toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and armodafinil efficacy/toxicity closely; consider dose adjustment of armodafinil if renal impairment develops; ensure adequate hydration during amphotericin B therapy.
